name: Agent Tool-Call Fine-Tune
headline: Train a small model to pick the right tool and emit valid JSON args.
description: An instruction-SFT template for teams building local agents (MCP servers, internal copilots, support bots) that need consistent tool-call behavior on cheaper hardware. Train a small model to read a user request plus a tool catalog and emit a single tool-call JSON object — exact tool name, correct arg shape, no hallucinated tools, no chatter. Pair with constrained JSON decoding at serve-time for hard guarantees.
suggested_brief: Train a tool-calling SLM. Input: user request + tool catalog. Output: single JSON object {"tool": "<name>", "args": {...}}. Validity rules: emit only tools from the catalog, no extra fields, JSON parseable on first try. When no tool fits, emit {"tool": "none", "args": {}} rather than hallucinating.
